selection_amendment.request: Use Khmer ASAG and MKQA instead of waiting for SEA-NLI.
selection_amendment.decision_basis: ASAG's consistency-filtered, deduplicated slice has only 23 test groups. Derived MKQA has substantially more entity/query groups; neither is a confirmatory native Khmer benchmark.

asag.decision: Secondary exploratory teacher-credit diagnostic on a selected consistent, unique-input slice, not universal correctness or an untouched holdout.
quality_findings: 118 rows have conflicting binned grades for identical normalized inputs; all excluded, with no preferred-label selection.
286 repeated input/label rows collapsed, one invalid score excluded and three incomplete inputs excluded at 2048 tokens.
Only 23 test question groups; 72 retained student hashes cross audit/test. Not unseen-student evaluation.
Reserved spot-check did not establish a grading rubric, factual correctness of references or native expert certification.
asag.responsible_use: No re-identification or contact with students, teachers or schools; no standalone high-stakes grading. Model input omits identity, class, school, year and score metadata.

mkqa.decision: Primary exploratory Khmer-query/English-entity-choice task, not standard MKQA or open-ended QA.
quality_findings: A reserved preview found Thai-script entity names in original km annotations. Use a uniform name vocabulary from English annotations for gold and distractors.
Require one accepted entity QID with English/Khmer agreement; 42 single-km-entity rows disagree across languages and are excluded.
Random distractors may be easy or semantically ambiguous; queries and historical answers may be awkward or dated.
Eight source IDs were inspected under the superseded rendering; retain their entire final components in audit. Exact IDs are in the manifest.
mkqa.interpretation: Agreement with this derived release. English choices and fixed whole-release label vocabulary are part of the benchmark definition; no target-trained model or performance-based selection.

audit.precision_assumption: Independent groups; not established, especially with shared ASAG students. Bounds are design diagnostics, not observed model CIs.

test.precision_assumption: Independent groups; not established, especially with shared ASAG students. Bounds are design diagnostics, not observed model CIs.

overlap_check.normalization: Unicode NFKC, retaining only characters whose Unicode general category begins L, N or M
overlap_check.adaptation_text: Single space joining each processed row's state values, in insertion order
overlap_check.comparison: Either normalized adaptation text is a substring of normalized flores_passage or the reverse; minimum length of the shorter string is 60 retained characters
overlap_check.exposure_scope: All adaptation source rows, including rows later assigned to calibration
limitations: Nonmatches do not exclude partial, near-duplicate, semantic or pretraining overlap.
Counts precede any audit reservation or manual label-quality review.
Whole-passage equality misses training sentences embedded in passages.

belebele.decision: Reject full set as clean unseen-text confirmation under the current gate. Reading-comprehension task and labels remain new, but adapted text exposure confounds that comparison. Nonmatching remainder is too small for confirmatory claims and is not fully audited.

sea_nli.access_check: No locally configured Hugging Face credentials; pinned payload download raised GatedRepoError. No access request submitted.
sea_nli.decision: Historical conditional candidate remains gated and unaudited. ASAG/MKQA replace it; its access approval is no longer an R007 prerequisite.

inspection_disclosure.note: A public Hugging Face page fetch exposed Biology Q7-Q10 student answers and grading labels before group reservation. Their connected groups are forced to audit. Reserved ASAG and MKQA samples were subsequently reviewed; do not describe this audit-informed derived study as untouched confirmation.

additional_test_exposure.disclosure: An accidental shell search output exposed model-facing MKQA test rows and gold labels before protocol lock. These rows and all final connected components containing them are quarantined in audit; they are not untouched test data.
